text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said analyst Gus Richard continues to see Applied Materials' stock as an "excellent long term investment," but the near-term "outlook remains cloudy."

-- In a written statement, Richard said the company will have a "difficult Q4." Also he expects "an increasing over-supply of DRAM (chips) in calendar Q1 1997" to diminish near-term prospects for the stock.

-- Applied Materials is expected to announce Q4 earnings on Thursday, November 21, and Richard said "it is very likely that street estimates for Applied Materials will be lowered after (a company) conference call."
-- He expects the company to meet Street estimates of $0.48 a share, fully diluted, and $850 million in revenue for the company's fiscal Q4, ending October.
-- He expects bookings to be close to Applied Materials' estimate of $700 million for Q4, and he believes bookings for fiscal Q1, ending January, will be at or below $700 million.
-- Applied Materials shares were off 1/4 at 31-3/4 in mid-morning exchange trading.
